tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa nag po zhabs lugs kyi sgrub thabs bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po spyod pa pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ / srid gsum gtso bo bdud bzhi'i dgra 'joms drag po che/ /phyugs bdag gau rīs mnyam par bdud pa he ru ka /khyod ni rtag dang chad mtha' las grol dbu ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i sdom pa mchog la gus pas 'dud/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba brtul zhugs kyi/ /spyod pa'i rol sgeg 'chang ba nag po'i gsung*/ /shin tu rtogs dka' rtogs na don che ba/ /'di don 'khrul med rab tu gsal bar bya/ /byin rlabs dal 'bab chu bo'i rgyun/ /dngos grub rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /sngags rig bye ba'i 'bab stegs 'dir/ /skal ldan gegs med 'du bar shog /de la 'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdagarje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'au/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/

lan gsum/ kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing*/ /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag/dpal ldan he ru kar bsgom bya/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka /sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍī ḍ+dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shriḥyaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko3 bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bor rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/

/sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// sgrub thabs dngos la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor dang mnyam lang gi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sngon du bya ba 'jug ldog gi sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos gzhi sgom pa'o/ /dang po la mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen spong ba gnyis so/ /dang po la rkyen bsod nams tshogs sogs dang*/ rgyu lam khyer gnyis so/ /de'i dang po rkyen bsod nams tshogs bsag ni/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i phyogs de khor ra khor yug tu mi bzad cing 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod chen po bdag med pa'i ngo bos khyab cing*/ dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid ro'i gdan la yang dag par gnas pa'i sgrub pa po rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma g.yon gyi cha nas nye bar bsten par mos te/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar sten pa'am/ nang mchod byin gyi rlabs te myangs la/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du/ hūṃ sngon po ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros lus thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gyur/ slar hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha' steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ na maḥshri tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ zhes pa'i phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta shri tsakra sam+bar maṇ+ḍal la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī/

zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe ni wi d+ya/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar du sbyar ba'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gsum brjod pa'o// de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi yang sgom mo/ /gnyis pa rgyu lam khyer gnyis ni/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing don sgom pa ni chos sku lam khyer ro/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo nā da dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rtsa sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa'o/ /zhes pa ni longs sku lam khyer te/ yang na hūṃ cha lnga pa bsgoms kyang legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'gal rkyen 'gog pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ de las 'og tu baṃ 'phros pa las sna tshogs pad ma raṃ 'phros pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ hūṃ 'phros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams shar sngo/

byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/ lte ba hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ kha gdong ma las steng du khwa gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma las 'og tu khyi gdong ma rnams dmar mo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ phyogs g.yon bskor dang*/ mtshams g.yas bskor du te lan gnyis brjod/ g.yon pa'i sdigs 'dzub phyogs bcur bstan zhing*/ se gol gdab pa'o// yang sum+bha/ tshar gcig brjod nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cigaces bka' bsgos pas/ pho nya rnams kyis bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ nag po'i rig can kha cig ni bsgral te bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas spar/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug ste 'ongs pa phyogs bcur 'khod pa/ hūṃ bcu las byung ba'i khron pa gru gsum zab cing rgya che ba bcu'i nang du bcug yang hūṃ las phur bu bcu spros pho nya rnams kyi lag par gtad/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor btsugs/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+taṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī la/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pā ya ti sarba bigh+naṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ yang hūṃ las thod pa bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad/ phur bu'i spyi bor brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal phyung nas de dag gi lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtogs pa thams cad bcom nas 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur zhing*/

smon lam gyi mthu las rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje las 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam la/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha ba ban+dha hūṃ/ de las phyogs mtshams su 'phros pa las rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng la song ba'i rwa bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ steng du 'phros pa las rdo rje rwa ba dang drwa ba'i gur du bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla rer bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ de'i phyir rol du 'obs dang bcas pa'i mda'i drwa ba mde'u bsnol ba phyir bstan pa srid pa'i rtse mo la thug par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ de thams cad kyi phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me ri 'bar ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa ste/ sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /pho nya rnams las rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa sprul te mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ rdo rje dra mig nas phar ro stod thon nas/ bsgrub pa pos ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos gzhi sgom pa la rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgoms pa dang*/ brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse mo gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa/ shar shel/ byang gser/ nub pad+ma rā galho baiḍūr+ya las grub pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ lcogs brgyad dang ldan pa/ thig le ser po dang bcas pa/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse mo gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa/ shar shel/ byang gser/ nub pad+ma rā ga /lho baiḍūr+ya las grub pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ thig le ser po dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar ba'i brtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi chun 'phyang dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dang*/ de'i steng du rin po che'i dra ba gser ma'i mda' yab kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus na in+d+ra ni la'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhi/ mchod rten zlum pa'i bang rim gyi dbyibs ltar cung zad je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ gtso bo'i gdan sna tshogs pad+mas dbus su brgyan pa'i chu skyes ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'am gri gug gis mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang*/

ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de las cung zad kyis dma' bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngo nag rtsibs brgyad pa/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de las cung zad kyis dma' bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ pad+mas mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de las cung zad kyis dma' bar sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ mtshams rnams su bum pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng na mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ sgo khang bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang*/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad ni/ shar du drag tu gtum pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ bden bral du mun pa mi zad pa/ rlung du ki li ki li'i sgra rab tu sgrog pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha dgod pa'o/ /shing brgyad ni/ shar du shi ri sha /byang du a shwo tha/ nub tu ka ko la/ lho ru tsu ta/ mer ka rañdza/ bden bral du la ta parka ti/ rlung du par ti pa ta/ dbang ldan du bha ṭa'o/ / phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du dbang po/ byang du gnod sbyin/ nub tu chu lha/ lhor gshin rje/ mer byin za/

bden bral du srin po/ rlung du rlung bdagadabang ldan du 'byung po'o/ /klu brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas/ byang du 'jog po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor pad+ma/ mer hū lun ta/ bden bral du rig ldan/ rlung du dung skyong*/ dbang ldan du pad+ma chen po'o/ /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ shar du sgra sgrogs pa/ byang du rmugs pa/ nub tu mun pa can/ lhor kun tu 'khyil/ mer gang ba/ bden bral du 'bab pa/ rlung du drag po/ dbang ldan du 'khrigs pa'o/ /shing rnams la brten pa'i zhing skyong rnams ni sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod de dag tu chu chen po brgyad dang*/ me chen po brgyad dang*/ mchod rten brgyad la sogs pas yongs su gang ba ste/ gzhan yang ro dang keng rus dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ dum bu dang*/ 'thor ba la sogs pas gang ba/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pa lang long rgyu zhing*/ lce spyang gi sgras khyab pa/ grub chen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob dpon dang dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can dang ro langs dang 'byung po dang srin mo dag sha za du mas khyab pa/ dngos grub kyi rdzas dang mchod pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan/ 'khor rnams la mi ro'i gdan re re'o/

/gnyis pa brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa la/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog ste gsum las/ dang po la bsnyen pa dang nyer sgrub dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ bsgrub chen te bzhi las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ dngos bzhi 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyi/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis 'khod/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyi/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pā pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha phrag gnyis bkod/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i bar du hūṃ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang thod pa hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres par bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dkar po khro bo chen po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/

ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag gi gdu bu dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang*/ ska rags dang*/ zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar gu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pa'i bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu ma'i gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis stobs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud pa gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo snyan rgyan mgur chu gdub bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ khrag gsol ba la dges shing*/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing*/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas yum gyi mngal gnas su skad cig gis lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ gtso bo yab yum rjes su chags pas kha sbyor nang gi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i bde ba sku nyams su star zhing rdo rje dang pad+ma'i 'khor lo'i lte ba lu gur rgyud du bcings pa'i sbyor bas 'dod chags chen po'i 'od zer thugs ka nas spros sems can gyi khams ma lus pa bkug nas nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi phye ba nas zhugs/

byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur bas sgrib pa gsum dgaye shes yongs su rdzogs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyis skur gyur nas phyir spros te skad cig de nyid la rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ dga' ba'i sgras nam mkha'i nā da'am hūṃ yig dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ bdag gi zhal nas zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa las yab yum gnyis 'od du zhu nas/ thig le'i rang bzhin 'od kyi phung po dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa dang*/ thig le las byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ su ra ta s+t+waṃ draṃ sh+ya ho/ zhes bskul/ sangs rgyas rnams thig le la thim te/ thig le de hūṃ dang aṃ gnyis su gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag ches cher khros pa drag shul chen po chags pa'i nyams dang 'dres pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal shin tu gnag pa/ g.yas zhal kun+da ltar dkar ba g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ser po gser ltar 'bar ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang*/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa zhabs yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu bskyel ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag gi gdu bu dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang*/ ska rags dang*/ zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa dang*/ dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgegs pa la sogs pa'i kar dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis stobs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud pa/ /gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shel can/ 'khor lo snyan rgyan mgur chu gdu bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ khrag gsol ba la dges shing*/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing*/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /sum+bha brjod pa'i zhal bzhi byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ oṃ dharma dha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo / / gnyis pa nyer bsgrub ni go cha 'god pa ste/ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/

spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyugaphrag pa gnyis su oṃ bau ṣaṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar oṃ haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa ste yab kyi gnas su yang yum dang*/ yum gyi gnas yang yab gnyis su med par gyur/ gsum pa bsgrub pa la rdo rje gsum byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ yab kyi snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ lkog mar oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dmar po gsung rdo rje/ dpral par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā kī nī dz+wa la saṃ pa raṃ swāhā/ dkar po sku rdo rje'o/ /yum gyi snying khar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā kī nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā nag po thugs rdo rje ma lkog mar oṃ tsau rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dmar po gsung rdo rje ma/ dpral bar oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ dkar po sku rdo rje ma'o/ / gnas lnga byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po mi bskyod pa/ ze'u 'bru la āḥdamar po snang ba mtha' yas/ lte bar swa ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/ brlar hā ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bzhi pa sgrub chen la bzhi las/ dang po ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas/

'khor lo bde mchog yab yum spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la g.yon du bsgyur zhing mig gyen du blta/ rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa gnon no// de nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod de dam tshig pa la bstim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad phaiṃ/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ dbang bskur bas lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ yab yum gyi snying po brjod cing nang mchod 'bul lo// bzhi pa rjes chags kyi rgyas gdab ni/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa ze'u 'bru'i nang du yi ge d+yā dmar po/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nor bu'i nang du yi ge byā dkar po'o/ /yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ rgyu thig le sgrub pa/ 'bras bu dkyil 'khor bskyed de spro ba/ yang dag byin gyis rlabs pa/ mchod cing bstod par bya ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs/ smin mtshams nas zhugs a wa dhu tī'i lam nas snying khar babs/ lte ba'i aṃ gi 'od kyis zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa de las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang 'khor lo'i rim pa bzhi lha'i gdan dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag ches cher khros pa drag shul chen po chags pa'i nyams dang 'dres pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal shin tu gnag pa/ g.yas zhal kun ltar dkar ba g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ser po gser ltar 'bar ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāṃ gabazhi pa gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar po'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas/ 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu brgyal ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag gi gdu bu dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang*/

ska rags dang*/ zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sha thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis stob pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs thams cad bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud pa/ gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo snyan rgyan mgur chu gdu bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan la/ khrag gsol ba la dges shing*/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing*/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā ma ljang skya/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar skya/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon pa rnams bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa la rim pas/ glang po che/ ce spyang skyes pa/ ba lang rnams kyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /mi ro'i steng du g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ / mtshams bzhir ma dang pha dang rgyal po dang*/ rgyal rigs gnyis kyi gang ba'i thod pa bzhi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu li ra ma la ya ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang*/

rab gtum mo/ byang phyogs dzā lan da rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nar kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs arbu ta ra mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lho gau dā wa rer su ra bai ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub rasmī shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma rū par aṃ ku ri dang e ra ba tī/ byang phyogs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs dri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wī/ lho nub laṃ ba kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ /nub byang kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rnam/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang*/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shaun+ṭi nī/ lho phyogs su war+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sid+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma ru ra rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu sta ra rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/

khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba/ he ru ka nyid dang mtshungs pa las zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbugs bral gyi gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i lha mo nyer bzhi rnams rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo nyid dang mtshungs pa las/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar du khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ lhor phag gdong ma ser skya/ shar lho gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad po thams cad kyang ches cher khros pa 'od zer 'bar ba bzhin shin tu 'gyur zhing sna tshogs su rnam par bsgyur ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ thor tshugs kyi nor bu dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ rdo rje'i ska rags dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas mgul ba brgyan pa/ rkang pa gnyis la dril bu g.yer khas spras pa/ shin tu g.yon brkyang bas ro gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o//

gsum pa ni/ bha ga'i gtso bo yab yum rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs thugs ka nas phyir spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas slar 'dus gcig tu 'dres yab dpal he ru ka snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus na rtsa a ba dhu tī hūṃ gi dbyibs can khams dpyid dang bcas pa la thim pa'i bcom ldan 'das dang*/ yum rdo rje phag mo lte ba'i aṃ yig dang rtsa'i gtso mo bzhi la thims pas rdo rje phag mor gyur te/ snying gar mnyam par sbyor ba ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag ches cher khros pa/ drag shul chen po chags pa'i nyams dang 'dres pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal shin tu gnag pa/ g.yas zhal kun+da ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ser po gser ltar 'bar ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag gi gdu bu dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang*/ ska rags dang*/ zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa dang*/

dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ /mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis stob pa g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdig mdzub kyi phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud pa/ gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can 'khor lo snyan rgyan/ mgur chu gdu bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ khrag gsol ba la dges shing*/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing*/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i yab kyi thugs kar hūṃ/ yum gyi thugs kar baṃ gnas pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros rnam par dag pa'i khams bzhi la bzhag ste phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir 'khod/ snying ga'i nang bskor gyi phyogs bzhi'i maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma bzhir gyur te/ de yang nang dang phyi'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā ma ljang skya/ nub tu khan+ḍa ro ha dmar skya/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug g.yon pa rnams bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa la rim pas/

glang po che/ ce spyang*/ skyes pa/ ba lang rnams kyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ skra sgrol ba/ phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi ro'i steng du g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi thod pa bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros/ rnam par dag pa'i phung po lnga la bzhag ste phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir 'khod/ snying ga'i mtshams kyi bdud rtsi lnga 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams kyang thod pa bzhir gyur/ de yang nang dang phyi'i mtshams bzhir ma dang pha dang rgyal po dang*/ rgyal rig gnyis kyis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros/ rnam par dag pa'i yul dang yul can la bzhag ste phyi'i 'khor lo gsum la 'khod/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas so sor/ pu dza o a go ra de mā/ ka o tri ko la kā hi/ pre gri sau sun si ma ku ste/ gnas rnams yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ khams rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang*/ rtsa rnams dpa' mo nyer bzhir gyur/ de yang spyi bo dang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu lī ra ma la yar khan+ḍa ka pā dang rab gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dang byang rtsibs dzā lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma rna ba g.yas dang nub rtsibs o ḍi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa dang lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ /rna ba g.yon dang shar lho go da wa rir su ra bai ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus dang lho nub rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis dang nub byang de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis dang byang shar mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/

/thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ /mchan khung gnyis dang gsung 'khor gyi shar rtsibs kā ma rū par aṃ ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis dang byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo*/ /lte ba dang nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse dang lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo*/ kha dang shar lho ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de waṃ/ mgrin par dang lho nub laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshan+dho ha'o/ /snying kha dang nub byang kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'bras bu dang byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste nye ba'i tshan+dho ha'o/ /gsung gis gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ /mtshan ma dang sku 'khor gyi shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam dang byang rtsibs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khan+ḍa ro hi ste 'du ba'o/ /brla gnyis dang nub rtsibs sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shaun+ṭi nī/ byin pa gnyis dang lho rtsibs su war+ṇa dwi par/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ /sor mo brgyad dang shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis dang lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma te dur khrod do/ /mthe bong gnyis dang nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis dang byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba/

he ru ka nyid dang mtshungs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbugs bral gyi gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i lha mo nyer bzhi rnams rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo nyid dang mtshungs pa las/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros rnam par dag pa'i las dang byed pa la bzhag ste dam tshig 'khor lo'i sgo mtshams brgyad du 'khod/ snying kha'i phyi bskor dang 'brel ba'i bu ga brgyad kyi rtsa rnams kyang sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur/ de yang kha dang shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ chu lam dang byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ bshang lam dang nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ sna bug gnyis kyi 'dom so dang lho sgor phag gdong ma ser skya/ rna ba g.yas dang shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ rna ba g.yon dang lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ mig g.yas dang nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ mig g.yon dang byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad po thams cad kyang ches cher khros pa 'od zer 'bar ba bzhin shin tu 'gyur zhing sna tshogs su rnam par bsgyur ba stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa thor tshugs kyi nor bu dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ rdo rje'i ska rags dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas mgul ba brgyan pa/ rkang pa gnyis la dril bu g.yer khas spras pa/ shin tu g.yon brkyang bas ro gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/

/mkha' nang gi rten gyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha nas phyir spros rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams la bzhag ste phyi'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ rang lus kyi skra sen pags pa rus tshigs rnams bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ gsum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ mig dang rna ba dang*/ sna dang lce dang mchu dang rgyu long la sogs pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan du gyur/ bzhi pa la/ dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab ste gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis las pho nya gsum bsre ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod de don bsam/ rdo rje'i dag pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ lan lnga brjod/ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha= sogs brjod cing*/ rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'khyud rgya bya/ gsum pa ni/ slar yang snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad phaiṃ/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin bshegs kun khrus gsol

ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ dbang bskur bas lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gyi rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur zhing*/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lha mo bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs 'khor ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor ba rnams la 'do dpag med/ sku 'khor ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan par bsam/ bzhi pa la dang por sngags mchod ni/ yab yum gyi snying po dang mkha' 'gro ma nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar gyi sngags rnams lan re brjod pa'o// phyi mchod ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūṃ bdun las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas dang gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing*/ thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pa d+yaṃ yang de ltar sbyar te/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi tā pra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe dra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ de nas nang mchod ni gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ rdo rje 'chang chen rang bzhin sku/

/thugs rje 'gro kun gdungs sel zhing*/ /bdag blo'i ku mud kha 'byed pa/ /rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /nag po spyod pa gu h+ya an+tar pa/ /te lo na ro pham ting sku mched mal/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sa chen bsod rtse rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa paṇa yon tan dpal dang la ru pa/ /gangs khrod pa dang theg chen chos rgyal la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i= kaṃ dgon pa dang paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ /brag dkar sems dpa' mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/ /grol mchog zhabs dang rje btsun rdo ring dbon/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i= yang na/ sa paṇa 'phags pa mang mkhar lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan byang chub seng ge dang*/ /shar pa ye rgyal chos rje kun bzang pa/ /rin chen bkra shis paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ zhes dang*/ grol mchog zhabs dang rje btsun lha dbang grags/ zhes te 'don pa spo/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa'o/ /'di la tshogs sgom pa nas brgyud pa'ang*/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba dang*/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal nas brgyud pa sogs sa paṇa man chad brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba snga phyir mang du yod do/ yang*/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dza lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa ba/ dge ba'i mgon po til+li nā ro dang*/ shes rab srung ba ka na ka shri /me dza ling pa rā lo chen po dang*/ /chos rab ye shes seng ge 'bum seng dang*/ /rong pa rga lo rong pa sher seng dang*/ /bla chen grags rgyal dar ma bzang po dang*/ /chos rje ri pa gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan grags pa rin chen dang*/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan blo gros rgya mtsho dang*/ /don grub legs pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa'o// mar do lugs kyang yod de 'dir re zhig ma bris so/ /de nas bsdu na gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'am/ spro na lha thams cad kyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i kyang nang mchod 'bul/ oṃ sarba badz+ra gā mi ni sarba bha k+ṣaṃ sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+ri ṇi swāhā/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni phyi nang gi lha thams cad mnyes par gyur nas rjes chags mdzad par bsam te/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan lnga'i mthar/ a nu rā ga'i sngags brjod cing*/ rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang*/ mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bya'o// yid mchod ni/ spyi bor nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu ni/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces se gol gdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā wārtā ya ā wārtā ya ho/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ a bhisma re s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ dhārmā dhā tu ā ka sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha le maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pri ṇi dha na/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na sab+ta swa s+thā na ba le na tsa swāhā/ zhes brjod la se gol gdab bo// de nas bstod pa ni cang te'u brdung zhing*/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kalpāg+ni san ni bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭo rka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ta ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu mrān+dha ka ra wa pu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha wa ga te badz+ra bā rā hī waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bid+ya shwa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ sar+b+ba bhu ta bha yāṃ wa ha mahā badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi de a pa ra dzi te bā shaṃ kā ri ni tra bh+ra ma ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ne hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mas+t+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pā rā dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā hī mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad do// gsum pa las rgyal mchog la gnyis las/ dag pa dran pa ni/ lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ khan+ṭa ro hā/ gzugs can ma bzhi'o/ /'dun pa dang brtson 'grus dang spyod pa dang sems te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ rab gtum ma/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma rnams so/ /dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyi dbang po lnga ni brtan blo ma/ mi'u thung ma/ laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma/ sa srungs ma rnams so/ /dad sogs kyi stobs lnga ni/ 'jigs byed ma/ rlung shugs ma/ chang 'thung ma/

ljang lha mo/ rab bzang ma rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ rnam 'byed dang*/ dran pa dang*/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ma/ 'khor shugs ma/ dum skyes ma/ glang sna ma/ go cha ma/ shin tu dpa' mo rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ ngag dang*/ las kyi mtha' dang*/ 'tsho ba dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa rnams ni stobs chen ma/ 'khor sgyur ma/ brtson chen ma/ khwa gdong ma/ 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma/ phag gdong ma rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa skyed pa dang*/ skyes pa bsrung ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi skyed pa dang*/ skyes pa spong ba bzhi ni/ gshin rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa phra thig gi rnal 'byor ni/ rnam pa mang po zhig yod pa las skabs 'dir 'khor lo bzhi'i gtum mo 'bar 'dzag dmigs bcas kyi mthar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spro ba sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i rim pa can no/ /gnyis pa mnyam langs kyi rnal 'byor la 'dir smos pa bzhi las/ dang po bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ mchog sgrub pa'am rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa la kha dog sngon po'am/ dmar po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba bsgom dgos la/ zhi ba la dkar po me tog 'phreng ba lta bu dal shing lhod pas 'gro ba dang*/ rgyas pa la ser po sgro'i chun po'i tshul dang*/ dbang la dmar po lcags sgrog gi tshul dang*/ drag po la nag po srad bu'i tshul gyis 'gro bar bsam la bzla'o/ /bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti bī rā+e shā ya/ mahā kalpāg+ni san+na bhā ya/ dza nā mu ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ daṃṣ+tā ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ ba ra dhā rā ya/

ma hā dhu mrān+dha ka ra ba pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān+ta mā lā ba lam+bi ni/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gsarbaṃ ba/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā ka ḍh+ya ā ka ḍh+ya/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dz+nyauṃ dz+nyauṃ*/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ haṃ haṃ/ hiṃ hiṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba tā+ai badz+ra bā rā hī baṃ/ ār+yā a pa rā dzi te/ trai lo kya mā te mahā bi d+ye shwa rī/ sarba bhu ta bha yā ma he mahā badz+re/ badz+ra a sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri nai dra bh+ra ma ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li nī/ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni/ a pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā hi mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge tad+ya thā/ pro taṅge pro taṅge/ ha na ha na/ prā ṇā na/ kiṃ ki ni/ khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ gaka pā la dhā ri ṇi/ mahā pi sha ta/ māṃ sā sha ni/ ma nu ṣ+yān+ta prā bṛ te/ san+ni dh+yāṃ na ra shi ro/ mā lā gran thi ta dhā ri ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ ha na ha na/ prā ṇāṃ/ sarbā pā paṃ sa twā nāṃ/ sarbā pā shu naṃ/ mahā māṃ sa ts+tshe da ni/ krodhā murti/ daṃṣ+tā ka rā li nā/ mahā mu dre/ shrī he ru ka /de ba s+ya a gra ma hi ṣi/ sa ha sra shi re/ sa ha sra bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra a na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khe/ piṃ ga la lo tsa ni/ badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ni/ mi li mi li/ ti mi li ti mi li/ he he/ hūṃ hūṃ/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a dwai te/ mahā yo gi nī/ pa ṭhi ta/ sid+dhi draiṃ dhaṃ draiṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me/

ha sa ha sa/ bhi me/ ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ ha ha/ hoḥhoḥ hūṃ hūṃ/ trai lo kya bi nā sha na/ sha ta sa ha sra/ ko ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri bā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ siṃ ha rū pe khaḥ ga dza rū pe gaḥ trai lo kya u da ri sa mu dra/ me kha le/ gra sa gra sa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bī rā dwai te/ hūṃ hūṃ/ hā hā/ ma hā pa shu mo ha ni/ mahā yo gī shwa rī tāṃ/ ḍā ki nī sarba lo kā nāṃ ban+dha naṃ sa d+yaḥpra d+ya kā ri ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bhū ta trā sa ni/ mahā bī re pa ra ma sid+dhi yo gi shwa rī phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+ba raṃ swāhā/ yab kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi nye snying dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi nye snying dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bhahūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya grih+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi nye ba'i snying po'i snying po dang*/ oṃ tsau rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi nye ba'i snying po'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khan+ṭa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsan+ṭe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan+ṭa k+ṣi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bī rā ma tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ oṃ ha/ oṃ na ma hi/ oṃ swāhā hūṃ/ oṃ bau ṣaṭa he/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ oṃ phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ oṃ baṃ/ oṃ hāṃ yoṃ/ oṃ hriṃ moṃ/ oṃ hriṃ hrīṃ/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa n-i go cha gnyis so/ /gnyis pa nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang lha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la thim/ de dam tshig gi 'khor lo la/ de yang sku'i 'khor lo la/ de yang gsung gi 'khor lo la/ de yang thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ de yang bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la/ de rang nyid la thim/ lha rnams phyogs g.yon bskor dang*/ mtshams g.yas bskor gyi sna bug nas snying gar bsdu'o// gsum pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar oṃ haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa ste yab kyi gnas su yang yum dang*/ yum gyi gnas su yang yab gnyis su med par gyur/

spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gri sau su na si ma ku/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings yab kyi rkang brgyad tshar gcig brjod/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma sogs dang*/ srid pa gsum 'bar sogs/ smon lam ci rigs pa btab nas spyod lam 'jug ste dag pa rnam pa gsum dang ma bral bas so/ /bzhi pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma gnyis sam/ gcig gis kyang rung ste/ chang chu nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa lta bu/ kha dog sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa/ kha dog dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral pa rang la bstan pa shin tu rgya che ba as mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du dbus su na las mi'i sha shar du go las ba glang gi sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las ta'i sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha sha re re'i steng du/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūṃ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bruṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dz+riṃ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor āḥyis brgyan pa/

de'i steng du hūṃ las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa'am rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog/rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga 'od du bzhu zhing bskol te tha mal pa sbyangs/ de'i rlangs kyi 'od zer steng du 'phros pas oṃ mgo bo thur du lta ba dang*/ zla ba dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga'am rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las bdud rts-i'i rgyun 'dzag pa dang 'dres pas bdud rtsir rtogs par bya/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga'am rdo rje hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsi bkang ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi bdud rtsi la thim ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas mtha' med du sbar/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'am rdo rje dang zla ba dang oṃ yang lhung ste/ zhu nas kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ

yang yang brjod do/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor chog la/ mgron bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs par bsam ste/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas la/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dgugs gzhug bcing dbang du bya'o/ /oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ 'khyud rgya bya/ ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po 'od kyi sbu gu can hūṃ gis mtshan pas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ar l+li hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+wam dri sh+ya ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ ba liṃ bhu dza thā bi pa tha/ ma ma kār+ya sā dha ya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swāhā/ zhes lan bdun sogs brjod/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūṃ aṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ/ pu dza o a/ go ra de ma/ kā o tri ko /ka la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku/ hūṃ brgyad kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis nang mchod 'bul/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzugs kyang*/ / mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad gegs med par stsal ba dang*/ myur du dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor chog ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya sngon du 'gro ba'i pad kor dang*/ phaiṃ badz+ra a rall̥ hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+wam dri sh+ya hoḥ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye bas/ oṃ kha kha/ kha hī kha hī/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+mā dā/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/
